description: Source file implementing the clearkey DRM session management, including key request handling, key response provisioning, and decryption functions.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Handles DRM session operations such as key requests, key responses, and decryption.

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request based on initialization data, MIME type, and key type.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Processes a key response, extracting keys from JSON Web Key Set and storing them.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted media data using the stored key corresponding to the provided key ID.
